title: Parking and backup camera usability
summary: Feedback on the G70's cameras centers on backup and parking use, with clear praise for camera quality in some reviews but many fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the cameras as excellent and highly liked by owners.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe parking camera limitations including small or poor-quality images and lack of front parking camera coverage.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention camera visibility, side cameras, backing out, requested continuous operation, and other camera-related remarks without enough context for a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing specific customer attitudes.
Some undetermined examples are very short or ambiguous, and one refers to traffic camera alerts rather than parking or backup camera image quality.
The topic includes related but not fully consistent subjects such as parking cameras, side cameras, backup visibility, and traffic camera alert behavior.
